Subject: NovaFlow renewal: staged capacity uplift + temporary rate hold proposal

Hi Sanjay —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation I put together a short proposal that aims to:
- keep your unit economics stable through a 12-month renewal,
- provide a staged capacity uplift as usage grows, and
- offer a temporary rate hold on existing committed tiers while you complete the migration of a secondary service to our Dedicated offering.

Key points in the attached ProForma:
- 12-month term starting 2027-07-01 with an initial commit footprint equal to current run-rate.
- Staged uplift schedule: +20% capacity at month 3, +35% at month 6 (optional trigger).
- Temporary rate hold: current per-token discount preserved for first 90 days after renewal effective date.
- One-time transition credit: $25k to offset onboarding and integration work.

I attached the ProForma and a draft SOW for the uplift plan. If Procurement needs a formal PO path or alternate wording on the rate hold clause, loop them in and we’ll propose redlines.

Next steps I suggest:
1) You confirm the uplift triggers (time vs. usage).
2) Procurement confirms PO cadence and acceptance of the credit wording.
3) We issue the DocuSign for signature.

Attachment: NovaFlow_Renewal_ProForma_v1.pdf (PDF, 142KB)
Attachment: SOW_staged-uplift.xlsx (Excel, 34KB)

Cheers,
Jordan

Subject: Fwd: NovaFlow renewal: staged capacity uplift + temporary rate hold proposal

FYI — Procurement asked for three asks: invoice-applied credit, extra 7.5% on uplift band if they commit, and 120-day hold. They want to push to CFO once we confirm.

My read: we can apply the $25k as invoice credit (ops ok), 7.5% on uplift band is aggressive but might be doable if we tie it to a minimum committed ARR (e.g., requires commit floor of 18 months or increase to the commit baseline), and 120-day hold is acceptable as a one-off for this customer given their strategic trajectory.

Proposed options to present back (pick one):
A) Standard: 90-day rate hold, $25k applied as first-invoice credit, no extra uplift discount (leverage staging flexibility).
B) Concession: 120-day rate hold, $25k invoice credit, 7.5% uplift discount applied only if NovaFlow signs a 24-month commitment on the uplift tranche (pass-through cap).
C) Accelerate: 120-day hold, $25k invoice credit, 7.5% uplift discount plus a modest onboarding fee ($10k) paid by customer to offset runbook/time.

Thoughts? If you greenlight B, I’ll draft the updated ProForma and send to Sanjay with the conditional language (and DocuSign link).

-Jordan
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: NovaFlow renewal: staged capacity uplift + temporary rate hold proposal

Jordan —

Thanks for the summary. I prefer Option B; it's a clean commercial tradeoff. Few notes from Finance/Legal:
- $25k can be applied as a deduction on the first invoice. Ops confirms no systems blocker.
- 7.5% uplift discount: Finance wants it gated to a signed addendum that includes the uplift commit floor (we should specify the exact commit metric: e.g., committed GPU-hours per month or committed token units).
- 24-month commitment language: Legal suggests we add an early termination true-up (pro-rated repayment of the uplift discount over the remaining contract months) to protect revenue.
- 120-day rate hold is okay but only if we include explicit language that Redispatch or burst beyond the agreed-upon overage tiers is billed at standard on-demand rates.

I’ll draft the pricing paragraph and the addendum clause. Karthik, if you can provide the minimum commit metric we should ask for (spend/commit tradeoff), that will let me calculate the net ARR impact.

Marissa Cole

Appreciate the fast turn. We can move forward on the concession path below (summary + next steps):

Commercial summary (concession — conditional):
- Term: 12 months effective 2027-07-01.
- Commit: baseline = current run-rate; uplift schedule = +20% at month 3, +35% at month 6 (trigger optional).
- Uplift discount: additional 7.5% on the month-6 uplift tranche, conditional on signing the Uplift Addendum (24-month minimum commitment for the uplift portion).
- Rate hold: 120 days from the effective date; standard on-demand rates apply to burst beyond agreed overage tiers.
- Transition credit: $25,000 applied as a deduction on the first invoice.
- True-up: early termination of the uplift addendum triggers a pro-rated repayment of the uplift discount (spread over the remainder of the 24-month uplift commitment).
